issues.title: Create organisation profile README in FINOS-style structure
issues.body: Create the `.github/profile/README.md` for Manchester AI Guild with sections for mission, focus areas, working model, repos, participation channels, and contribution path.

issues.title: Publish core repository README in governance-first format
issues.body: Set repository `README.md` for `manchester-ai-guild` using the governance-first narrative and FAQ structure.

issues.title: Add complete attendee and ecosystem directory to docs
issues.body: Publish all individuals and meetup/ecosystem entities from the session dataset with no omissions.

issues.title: Enable GitHub Pages and publish Manchester AI Guild landing page
issues.body: Configure Pages via GitHub Actions and deploy `/docs` as the initial public landing site.

issues.title: Seed project board with governance, launch, community, and operations streams
issues.body: Create project board columns and seed initial issues with labels and milestone assignment.

issues.title: Define branch protection, CODEOWNERS, and repository security baseline
issues.body: Apply baseline controls on `main`: PR review requirements, status checks, Dependabot, and secret scanning.
